goal: SMOKE TEST: a UR10 (suction) and a Franka (parallel-jaw) working together in ONE scene. Each picks its own cube from its own feeder and places into its own bin; the two bins sit near the centre so the arms reach toward each other (exercises the multi-robot sibling keep-out). Both robots front-picking (dexterous) to isolate the MIXED-TYPE COEXISTENCE question (two different-config cuRobo planners + suction & jaw grips in one Kit), not the UR10 swing. Answers Anton's 'what happens with UR10+Franka together?'
thoughts: Per-config planner caching (_curobo_pp_planner_v22_<cfg>) gives each robot its own planner (ur10_scene.yml vs franka.yml). Per-robot family gating handles suction (UR10) vs jaw (Franka). _sibling_keepout_cuboids adds each robot as a keep-out in the other's cuRobo world (type-agnostic, pose-based). Multi-robot reset_seed fires for both. UNTESTED for mixed types (only dual-Franka verified) — this template is the smoke test.
